annotations.title: Grade a hardware interview practice answer

description: Grades an answer to a hardware interview practice problem, exactly as the breadboardhub practice page does. For a design problem, send the Verilog module: it is built with Yosys, its ports are checked and the hidden test runs on it. Returns pass or fail, how many test steps pass, and the first failing step with its inputs and expected outputs, or the build errors. For a find-the-bug problem, send a test: it reports whether the test passes the correct design and how many buggy versions it catches. Signed-in accounts get the attempt saved to their progress. Counts toward an hourly build limit.

test.description: Find-the-bug problems: the test, as { "clock": "clk", "steps": [{ "set": { "rst": 1 }, "tick": 1, "expect": { "count": 0 } }] }. "set" drives inputs, "tick" applies clock edges, "expect" checks outputs; leave "clock" out for a design without one.

verilog.description: Design problems: the Verilog source, with the module name and ports the problem gives (at most 20,000 characters).
